slides.title: Water in motion
bullets: Water moves between Earth's surface and the air.
Sunlight provides energy for this cycle.

slides.title: Evaporation
bullets: Warmer water tends to evaporate faster.

slides.title: Condensation
bullets: Water vapor cools and forms tiny droplets.
Collections of droplets can make clouds.

slides.title: Precipitation
bullets: Water falls from clouds as rain or snow.
Gravity pulls the falling water downward.

slides.title: Collection
bullets: Water collects in rivers, lakes, and oceans.
Some of the water soaks into the ground.

questions.question: What provides energy for the water cycle?
questions.explanation: Sunlight provides energy that helps water evaporate.

questions.question: What is liquid water becoming vapor called?
questions.explanation: Evaporation changes liquid water into water vapor.

questions.question: What can droplets form when they gather?
questions.explanation: Tiny droplets gather to form clouds.

questions.question: Where can water collect?
questions.explanation: Rivers are one place water can collect.
